news.title: S&P upgrades Uzbekistan to ’BB+’ on fiscal reforms and stronger external buffers
news.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded Uzbekistan’s long-term foreign- and local-currency sovereign credit ratings to 'BB+' from 'BB' on Friday, placing the Central Asian nation one notch below investment grade with a stable outlook. The agency cited strengthening economic policymaking, ongoing energy and state-owned enterprise (SOE) reforms, and an improved external liquidity position bolstered by elevated gold prices.
